name: Mint Byrne
source:
An Ultimate with rather bittersweet circumstances surrounding how he aqquired his talent. Despite the tragedy of that event, it's undeniable the impact his work has had on the resurgence of traditional medicine and herbal remedies in medical care. He's made treatments more accessible and ultimately had a pretty positive impact on the world.

Despite this Mint is a fairly quiet, slightly timid young man. He's quick to flinch or apologise, trying the best he can to make himself seem invisible to the other Prisoners. But it seems that when he's set off he can be surprisingly firm and stand up for others. He has a strange friendship(?) with one of the other prisoners.

When interrogated he almost had a panic attack, he apologised for his crime but I couldn't help but think he was being ingenuine. He couldn't look me in the eyes.

[From the [url=https://danganronpa-fanganprojects.fandom.com/wiki/Mint_Byrne_(Danganronpa_Antebellum:_LOCKDOWN)]Wiki[/url]]
